caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different amount of weights
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of a Whisper model with different weight configurations. The x-axis represents the epoch, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, and tick labels at every integer interval. The y-axis represents the WER, with a linear scale ranging from 25.0 to 42.5, and tick labels at every 2.5 interval. There are four lines in the plot: small AdaLoRA_int4, shown as a dashed orange line with circle markers, starts at approximately 35.5 and decreases to around 31.5; small AdaLoRA_int8, shown as a dashed orange line with square markers, starts at approximately 30.0 and decreases to around 25.5; small int4, shown as a dotted orange line with diamond markers, starts at approximately 40.5, peaks at around 42.0 at epoch 2, and decreases to around 30.5; and small int8, shown as a solid orange line with square markers, starts at approximately 32.5 and decreases to around 25.
